provisional.bannerDescription: This chart is calculated using the mid-day hour (11:00 - 13:00) as a reference baseline. Life Palace, Body Palace, individual palaces, and decadal cycles are provisional estimates. You can add your exact birth hour anytime to view a fully accurate chart.
provisional.insightsDisclaimer: Note: The following insights are provisional reference estimates because exact birth time is unknown.
